author: Matt Lenzie / Construction Capital
scope: Blank organisational template. No observed project data, automatic legal status or lender acceptance. Keep completed project information private.

field_definitions.record_type: condition, planning_obligation, other_contribution or unresolved; have the category reviewed.
field_definitions.permission_or_agreement_reference: Exact project document reference; do not assume relevance from a search result.
field_definitions.document_version_and_date: Version/date of the source used for this entry.
field_definitions.source_requirement_text: Relevant wording, retained in the private project copy.
field_definitions.trigger_interpretation: Working interpretation and any unresolved scope or timing question.
field_definitions.required_deliverable: Specific evidence or task still required.
field_definitions.task_owner: Person responsible for obtaining the deliverable.
field_definitions.submission_date: Actual date if submitted; blank is unknown, not complete.
field_definitions.response_record: Reference/date/outcome of actual response; separate from submission.
field_definitions.continuing_action: Action still required after any recorded approval, if applicable.
field_definitions.programme_activity: Activity or phase potentially dependent on the entry.
field_definitions.target_date_and_basis: Target date, whether assumed or confirmed, and basis.
field_definitions.funding_question: Separate question to resolve for the relevant finance stage/document.
field_definitions.evidence_reference: Private file/location reference for the actual supporting evidence.
field_definitions.reviewer_and_review_date: Person checking the entry and date of that review.
field_definitions.next_action_and_review_date: Unresolved step and next review date.
